lines.en: : But if you two actually kept going, what would I even do? Pull her off of you and risk breaking your penis?
lines.zh: : 但要是你们两个真继续下去了，我又能怎么办？把她从你身上拽下来、冒着折断你鸡巴的风险？

lines.en: : Or {i}join in{/i}.
lines.zh: : 或者{i}加入{/i}。

lines.en: scene norikounderwear26
with dissolve
: No~
: I want my first sexual experience to be all alone with you.
lines.zh: : 我想让我的第一次只有你和我两个人。

lines.en: : But some of the ones after that can involve Kirin too if you want. I bet she’s a freak.
lines.zh: : 不过之后的某些次可以带上 Kirin，如果你愿意的话。我打赌她是个变态。

lines.en: : I’m honestly a little surprised at how okay you are with this.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你能接受这些，我有点惊讶。

lines.en: scene norikounderwear25
with dissolve
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : I feel like most people who claim to be in love with someone despise the idea of that person being with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我觉得大多数说自己爱上了某人的人，都会厌恶那个人跟别人在一起这个念头。

lines.en: : As long as you love {i}me{/i}, I think I’d be okay with it.
lines.zh: : 只要你爱{i}我{/i}，我想我就能接受。

lines.en: : Expecting someone to not want to have sex with someone they find attractive is unrealistic.
lines.zh: : 指望一个人不想跟自己觉得有吸引力的人上床，本来就不现实。

lines.en: : Of course, there's always a chance I'd hate it once we actually try. But I’m open to trying.
lines.zh: : 当然，等我们真的试了，我也完全有可能讨厌那种感觉。但我愿意试。

lines.en: : Eventually. Not now, of course.
lines.zh: : 总有一天。当然不是现在。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s become very apparent tonight.
lines.zh: : 是啊，今晚这一点变得非常明显了。

lines.en: : Perverted and prudish at the same time. Noriko Nakayama.
lines.zh: : 又变态又守旧。Noriko Nakayama。

lines.en: : Being nervous doesn’t make you a prude. You didn’t even kick me out of the room.
lines.zh: : 紧张又不是守旧。你甚至都没把我赶出房间。

lines.en: : Perverted and embarrassed doesn’t have the same ring to it. It’s missing alliteration.
lines.zh: : “变态”和“害羞”放在一起就没有那个味道了。少了头韵。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess you’re right about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想你说得对。

lines.en: : Any other questions for me? I actually kind of like this.
lines.zh: : 还有别的问题要问我吗？我其实挺喜欢这个的。

lines.en: : Just one more.
lines.zh: : 就最后一个。

lines.en: : Bring it on.
lines.zh: : 放马过来。

lines.en: scene norikounderwear27
with dissolve
: Are you in love with anyone right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在爱着什么人吗？

lines.en: : And I’m not talking about any residual love for Nee-chan that might still be in there somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是还残留在某个角落里、对姐姐的爱。

lines.en: : I’m talking about all of the girls in the class.
lines.zh: : 我说的是班上的所有女生。

lines.en: : Is there any one girl you look at and think about spending the rest of your life with?
lines.zh: : 有没有哪一个女生，你看着她就会想跟她共度余生？

lines.en: : And, follow up question, what are my chances of becoming that girl?
lines.zh: : 还有个追加问题，我成为那个女生的几率有多大？

lines.en: : I’m not in love with anyone right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不爱任何人。

lines.en: : In fact, I’ve pretty much accepted that I never will be.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我基本已经接受了：我永远不会。

lines.en: : Not even if you find one person who’s perfect for you in every way?
lines.zh: : 就算你找到一个在各方面都完美适合你的人也不爱？

lines.en: : Who lets you sleep with other girls and will do anything you ask of her?
lines.zh: : 她让你跟别的女生睡，还愿意做任何你要求的事？

lines.en: : Who will outlive you and never see someone else even after you die?
lines.zh: : 她会活得比你久，就算你死了也再不看别人一眼？

lines.en: : Who you’ve known for your entire life?
lines.zh: : 你从小就认识的人？

lines.en: : You’re really campaigning hard for this role, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你为了这个角色真是拼了命在竞选啊，不是吗？

lines.en: scene norikounderwear28
with dissolve
: Mhm~
: I was born for it.
lines.zh: : 我就是为它而生的。

lines.en: : And I’ll definitely make it happen someday.
lines.zh: : 而且我总有一天一定会做到的。

lines.en: : I swear.
lines.zh: : 我发誓。

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve2
I never answer that last question.
lines.zh: 我始终没有回答最后那个问题。

lines.en: Which is a little strange, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 现在想想，这有点奇怪。

lines.en: What would be preventing me from falling in love with someone who would be perfect for me in every sense of the word?
lines.zh: 有什么能阻止我爱上一个在每一个意义上都完美适合我的人？

lines.en: Who would let me sleep with other girls.
lines.zh: 愿意让我跟别的女生睡。

lines.en: Who will outlive me and stay loyal long after I’m gone.
lines.zh: 会活得比我久，在我走后很久依然忠诚。

lines.en: Who I’ve known forever.
lines.zh: 我认识了一辈子的人。

lines.en: What stands in the way of me and all of those things?
lines.zh: 是什么挡在我和所有这些东西之间？

lines.en: And why is it so wide that I can’t even find an edge to peer around it?
lines.zh: 而它为什么这么宽，宽到我连绕过它看一眼边缘都找不到？
